full_page.content:
1935, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NC. 5.
Page 290 Cont.
Jan. 13 Rev. Jas. J. O'Mara - in S.W. - Pneufritis Kidney trouble
Joseph Kowalizyk - 18 - hurt four yrs ago - weak minded ever since. Mother anxious asks prayers.
Hen Huetteman - 42 - has wife & 3 - blood poison - blood trans fu- sion to-morrow - was anointed and received last. .. Today.
Page 291 Page 292
Blank Page
Jan. 16 Rita Davidson - 18 - Providence Hosp. operation yesterday - Spinal -manengitis feard
Stanley Gieleghen - 12 - Fits . ..
Lytle ... missunderstanding ...
16 Bernice Ristau - 25 - stomach disorder and nervous ....
Ross Simpson - 34 - drinking quarrels with wife & daughter & strikes them.
Clarence Golla - 32 - in Jackson lost mind since there now 4 yrs.
19 Cath Gildow - 63 - bleeding continually from what every indication was a cancerous groth. On December 10 last Enrolled herself in Ser. Mass A. after 3 mo's anxiety. Blood stopped instantly after en- rollent - now almost a week gone - keeps promise of enrolling.
Maria Gildaw - 25 - lost mind two yrs. ago very bright girl ... Now hopeful ....
Mrs. An Vanwinkel ... fears groth on left breast ....
Everet Williams - 38 - non C. (method. ) drinking - Family distressed ... try as he seems.
Page 293 Page 294
Blank Page
Jan. 21 Dennis Lynch - 46 - cancer of lungs - Ford Hospital. ... Kate Campbell - 46 - Mental.
